correctness.rationale: The exact pointwise Carathéodory entropy differentiation cancels both skew quadratic terms (row balance keeps the fixed point) and produces two nonnegative dissipation squares. The explicit scalar Taylor upper bound gives the displayed global exponential rate; 48 exact rational derivative checks and a strongly switching numerical trajectory corroborate independently of the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The explicit positive-cone global stability and exponential rate remain valid for arbitrarily large and arbitrarily rapid balanced predator–prey switching at fixed finite maturation; an explicit nonzero cyclic 3-species network shows this is not the uncoupled trivial case. This directly clarifies what structured antagonism can achieve beyond the finite-demography spectral stability boundary studied by the 2026 primary source. The uniform interaction-independent rate is a useful exact robustness guarantee, and the infinitesimal rate has a sharp uniform benchmark.
